cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I've calculated the optimal move in this raffle. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You buy a ticket. That's all.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. The timing of purchase is crucial.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely the variable I was waiting for you to confirm.
